mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand, which drives corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise simultaneously (t-test p > 0.05), or interaction IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO falls below its 12-month MA (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising above 3.0% annually, the market anticipates prolonged monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during high-FEDFUNDS/high-CPIAUCSL periods (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction IC < -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) on a quarterly basis, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates a robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed thresholds (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% combined with rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 133000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction IC < -0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100, combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a weakening economy with declining output and rising joblessness, which triggers risk-off behavior and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 5.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or interaction IC < -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
